 Oprah says: "Know someone who likes to walk out the door with just the essentials? In this leather crossbody, a phone snaps into its own slot and a zip pocket holds cards and keys. It's light enough that they'll forget it's even there."
 50% off Bandolier Bandolier: Bags
 Keep your phone close, your hands free and your style intact. Bandolier founder Maggie Drake was tired of losing her phone and missing calls and photo moments. The Dillon Pouchette is a soft pebble leather phone bag with a drawstring shape and Bandolier's signature exterior phone pocket. Compact, chic, and easy to wear, it keeps your phone close while leaving room for the small things you need on the go. The Taylor Bag is made for your phone and everything else. Crafted from smooth leather with gold hardware, featuring a dedicated front phone pocket with a secure turn-lock closure, keeping your most important things secure and close at hand. The soft, elegant silhouette includes two interchangeable straps -- crossbody or shoulder -- so you can carry it your way. Totes, crossbodies and more are available. Limit five per product.  50% off As ever As ever: Pantry Items
 Elevate everyday experiences from the pantry to the table and throughout the home. As ever is more than a brand. It's a love language, created by Meghan, the Duchess of Sussex, inspired by her love of cooking, gardening, gathering and gifting. The Signature Fruit Spread Gift Box includes a curated trio of As ever fruit spreads -- Orange Marmalade, Raspberry Spread and Strawberry Spread -- inspired by the homemade jams the duchess has crafted and shared over the years, each spread reflects a small-batch, carefully balanced approach to flavor. Perfect for toast and pastries, spooned over yogurt, paired with cheese, or enjoyed in everyday moments around the table. Flower Sprinkles are a blend of tiny vibrant edible flower petals that act as confetti for plating. This addition epitomizes the idea of "surprise and delight," beautifying any dish and taking it from mundane to magical. As easy as a dash of salt, the flower sprinkles offer a dash of beauty to each bite. Teas and spice kits are also available. Shipping is $6.99 or free over $100. $6 - $21

 Enhance natural beauty with Anastasia Beverly Hills. The brand was founded 26 years ago by Romanian-born entrepreneur and beauty industry icon Anastasia Soare and quickly garnered celebrity clients and devoted fans. The Velvet Muse Limited Edition Lip Velvet Lip Trio features three full-size Lip Velvet shades: the bestselling Hush Rose plus two new shades, Crimson Kiss and Twilight Fig. Lip Velvet is a velvet-smooth lip mousse with weightless, full pigment, true-matte color; cushioned, comfortable wear; and a smoothing lip finish that allows you to line and apply with a multifunctional, teardrop-shaped cushioned wand. These curated shades make it easy to create effortless looks all season long. Favorite brow products like Brow Wiz, an ultra-slim, retractable eyebrow pencil designed to add definition and hair-like detail to the eyebrow with maximum precision and control, plus foundation, eyeshadow stick, lip balm vault, and more are available. Turn a quiet night into something special. Hand-finished by skilled artisans in a chunky, textured stitch, the alicia adams alpaca lounge sock is a plush silhouette made from 100% alpaca and built for slowing down. The thick knit holds in warmth while staying breathable, so the sock feels substantial without ever feeling heavy. It is especially kind for sensitive feet, and the fiber keeps its loft and softness for a long time. Designed for evenings by the fire, a good book, and slow mornings in.
